description: Get a temporary upload URL (valid 1 hour) to send a file of the eBook: kind=pdf — your own PDF as the eBook of a language that has no eBook yet (up to 15 MB); kind=logo — a PNG/JPEG logo for the eBook (up to 5 MB). The URL is a credential: don't show or share it. Send the file with an HTTP PUT to upload_url with the Content-Type header exactly as returned. Then: PDF → panda_confirm_ai_ebook_pdf; logo → pass logo_key in ebook_config of panda_update_ai_resource (existing eBook) or panda_generate_ai_resource. Your client must be able to send files over HTTP; otherwise use the dashboard (Video Settings → Panda AI → eBook).

lang.description: pdf: language of the eBook. Default: the video's language

name: panda_get_ai_ebook_upload_url
title: Get AI eBook Upload URL
